app.name: AnyTools
app.tagline: Learn from your own documents, with your own AI.

sources.title: Sources
sources.empty: Nothing is cited yet. When an answer quotes one of your documents, the passage and its page number appear here, so you can check the claim against the original instead of trusting the summary.

margin.title: In the margin
margin.practise: A point you get wrong comes back the same day. A point you know comes back just before you would forget it. Mastery is counted from answers, never from time spent.
margin.reflect: Five minutes to start, fourteen days to test one change, ninety days to decide whether to keep it. The loop only moves on evidence you have already recorded.
margin.home: AnyTools runs on your own AI accounts and answers only from documents you give it. Nothing here is a plan or a credit balance.

home.lead: Choose one thing to do first, then decide how far to go.
home.body: Every answer it does give carries the passage it came from, down to the page. The same rule holds for progress later on: a quiz result, a mastery level or a finished cycle has to point at the work that earned it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: AnyTools runs on your own AI accounts. There are no platform keys and no credits, so nothing here is a plan or an upgrade. It is which of your accounts does which job.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.allReady: Every core capability has a connection that answers. Documents can be read, indexed and asked about.
readiness.notReady: Something core is missing. Until it is fixed, the affected parts of AnyTools cannot run at all. They will not quietly fall back to anything.
readiness.unavailable: AnyTools could not reach its API just now, so it cannot say what is ready.

functionHelp.chat: Answers questions from your documents, with citations.
functionHelp.parse: Turns an uploaded PDF into text AnyTools can quote, page by page.
functionHelp.embed: Turns your documents into vectors so they can be searched. Changing the model here means re-indexing.
functionHelp.quiz: Writes questions with answers and explanations.
functionHelp.mastery: Builds and scores the mastery path.
functionHelp.solve: Works a problem step by step.
functionHelp.research: Writes a sourced report. Its web-search key is separate, under Search keys.
functionHelp.rerank: Reorders retrieved passages before an answer is written.
functionHelp.tts: Speaks audio overviews in two voices: an OpenAI key, or your own OpenAI-compatible speech server (your own Kokoro, say). Optional: the server's built-in voices or your browser can speak a script too.
functionHelp.stt: Transcribes videos and audio that have no captions. Optional: an OpenAI key (whisper-1), a Groq key (whisper-large-v3-turbo, or whisper-large-v3), your own OpenAI-compatible Whisper server (name its model), or a Gemini key, which reads a public YouTube video's URL. The server's built-in engine, when it runs one, needs no key.

connections.addBody: Paste a key from Google AI Studio, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Qwen (Alibaba Cloud), Mistral, xAI, Groq or Z.AI, or the base URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The key is encrypted before it is stored and is never shown again, here or anywhere else.
connections.name: Name
connections.namePlaceholder: What you will call this key
connections.baseUrlHelp: Leave empty to use the provider's own endpoint. Required for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Must be https, and must not point at a private or internal address.
connections.keyHelp: Stored encrypted. AnyTools never sends it anywhere except the provider you chose.
connections.empty: Nothing is connected yet, so nothing can run. Add a key above.
connections.notVerified: Not verified yet. Verify checks the key against the provider with one small real call.
connections.needsReconnect: This connection's token expired and could not be renewed. Reconnect it.
connections.confirmRemove: Remove this connection? Anything routed to it stops working until you route something else.

drive.title: Documents
drive.name: Google Drive
drive.body: Connect Google Drive to add documents from it to a knowledge base. AnyTools can read only the files you pick in Google's own picker, and keeps them in sync.
drive.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect Google Drive? AnyTools' access is revoked at Google and syncing stops. Documents already added stay in their knowledge bases.
drive.needsReconnect: Google stopped accepting this connection, so nothing is syncing. Reconnect to continue.
drive.rePick: {{count}} file(s) must be picked again from the knowledge base that holds them.
drive.unavailable: Google Drive's status could not be loaded right now.
drive.inDriveDisconnected: AnyTools keeps {{count}} of your files in your Google Drive, and cannot open them until you reconnect it.
drive.disconnectFilesStay: Your files stay in your Google Drive, in the “AnyTools” folder.
drive.disconnectFilesClosed: AnyTools cannot open them again until you reconnect. Search and chat keep working from their text.
drive.disconnectFilesMove: You can move them back to AnyTools' server first.

connections.providerHelp: Only Gemini, OpenAI and Anthropic can read scanned PDFs. To index documents you need one that embeds: Gemini, OpenAI, Mistral or Qwen. The others answer, quiz, solve and research.

routes.lead: Each capability runs on the connections you list, in order: if the first is out of quota or refuses, AnyTools tries the next. Leave a position empty to end the chain.
routes.noConnections: There is nothing to route yet. Add a key under Connections first.

search.lead: Research can read the web as well as your documents, using a search key of your own. There is no shared key: without one, research still works; it just answers from your documents only. An OpenAlex key is optional and only for scholarly papers: without one, AnyTools uses OpenAlex's free daily allowance, shared by everyone on this server.
search.empty: No search key. Research runs against your own documents only.

experimental.title: Experimental subscription lanes
experimental.warning: These lanes are unofficial. They make AnyTools sign in as software the provider made for your own machine (the ChatGPT and Codex CLI, VS Code's Copilot extension, Claude Code, the Gemini tools), which none of OpenAI, GitHub, Anthropic or Google licenses for use through another app. Your account may be restricted or closed as a result. The Gemini lane also asks for broad Google Cloud access, so the token stored here can reach far more than AI. An ordinary API key is the reliable choice; use these only if you accept that.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT subscription (relay)
chatgpt.body: AnyTools cannot sign you in to ChatGPT: that sign-in only completes on your own computer. Obtain the tokens yourself and paste them here. AnyTools will store them encrypted and renew them.
chatgpt.expiresIn: Seconds until the access token expires

gemini.title: Gemini Code Assist
gemini.body: Two steps. Enter a redirect address registered with this deployment's Google OAuth client to get a consent link, then paste the authorisation code Google gives you. This also needs a Google account that has a Code Assist tier.
gemini.openConsent: Open Google's consent screen, then copy the code it returns

copilot.title: GitHub Copilot
copilot.body: Uses your Copilot plan. Start, enter the code on GitHub, approve, then finish here. Needs an active Copilot seat. Chat-type jobs only: it cannot read PDFs or index documents.

claude.title: Claude Pro or Max
claude.body: Uses your Claude plan. Open the link, approve, then paste the code Claude shows (it looks like code#state). Codes work once and expire within minutes. Chat-type jobs only: it cannot read PDFs or index documents.

account.deleteBody: This deletes your account and everything in it: documents and their files, knowledge bases, conversations, questions, notes, mastery paths and your learning loop. Your Google Drive and Gemini grants are revoked at Google. Keys you pasted are deleted here; revoke them with their provider too if you no longer want them to exist. A ChatGPT subscription connection is deleted here too, but OpenAI offers no way for AnyTools to revoke its token, so sign out of ChatGPT on your devices if you want it ended at OpenAI. This cannot be undone.
account.confirmLabel: Type your email address to confirm
account.deleteSubmit: Delete my account and all its data
account.mismatch: That is not the email address of this account.
account.failed: The account could not be deleted.
account.zoneBody: AnyTools decides what "today" and "tomorrow" mean in this zone: when a mistake counts as fixed, when a retest is due, and when your review day starts. It was taken from your browser the first time you signed in.
account.zoneInvalid: That is not a time zone AnyTools knows. Pick one from the list, such as Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
account.deleteDrive: Files you chose to keep in Google Drive are not deleted: the “AnyTools” folder stays in your Drive, and it is yours to keep or delete.

landing.title: Study from your own documents.
landing.lead: AnyTools is free tools that run in your browser with no account, and a study app for what you are learning. Upload the material you are learning from, and AnyTools answers questions about it with citations that open the exact page, writes quizzes from it, schedules what you are about to forget, and keeps a 90-day record of what you can actually do, all on the AI accounts you already pay for.
landing.ctaNote: Free. Google or GitHub sign-in; no password.

cite.title: Answers that point at the page
cite.body: Chat, quizzes and research cite the passage they used. A citation opens your document at that page, so a claim can be checked instead of trusted.

byok.title: Your own AI accounts
byok.body: Connect a key from Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral or another supported provider. There are no platform keys and no credits: nothing runs until one of yours is connected, and you choose which account does which job.

practice.title: Practice that schedules itself
practice.body: Questions are written from your material and marked with an explanation. A mastery path brings back what you got wrong the same day, and what you know just before you would forget it.

evidence.title: Progress backed by evidence
evidence.body: A 90-day learning loop moves forward only when quiz results, reviews and notes show it should, not when a box is ticked.

landing.notBody: AnyTools does not answer from its own general knowledge when your documents are silent; it says they do not cover the question. It does not keep streaks, points or badges. And it cannot promise that a file never reaches an AI provider: reading a document means sending it to the model you chose, and every document shows which one read it.
landing.footer: AnyTools is in early access. Your documents and connected accounts stay yours; you can remove any of them at any time.

tools.title: Appendix: free tools, no account
tools.body: More than a hundred everyday tools: formatters, encoders, converters, calculators, and PDF and image tools. They run in your browser, need no sign-in, and come in English, Vietnamese, Spanish and Portuguese.

landing.lede: Answers that cite the page, quizzes written from your material, and reviews timed to just before you forget.

githubToken.hint: A GitHub token is only for importing private repositories into a knowledge base. Make a fine-grained token with read-only access to Contents, choose “github” above, and paste it. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.

zoteroKey.hint: A Zotero key lets you add items from your own library to a knowledge base, and lets research search it. Create a read-only key at zotero.org/settings/keys (allow library access, and file access for PDFs); the same page shows your numeric user ID.
zoteroKey.userHint: The number zotero.org/settings/keys shows as "Your user ID for use in API calls".

youtubeDataKey.hint: A YouTube Data API key lets a YouTube playlist in a knowledge base list all its videos (up to 500) instead of the latest 15. Make a key for the YouTube Data API v3 in Google Cloud, choose “youtube_data” above, and paste it. AnyTools uses it only from its server; it is stored encrypted and never shown again.

driveStorage.reconnect: AnyTools cannot open this file until you reconnect Google Drive. Nothing is lost, and search still uses its text.
driveStorage.removed: This file was removed from your Drive. Upload it again to put it back, or delete it from AnyTools. Search still uses its text.
driveStorage.full: Your Google Drive is full, so this file was not kept. Free some space in your Drive and try again.
